votes.motion: Approve the boundary of state and local wetland resource areas at 790-792 Massachusetts Avenue (Abbreviated Notice of Resource Area Delineation filed by Gary Archer).
Issue a negative determination for installation of solar panels at 322 Flat Hill Road (Request for Determination of Applicability filed by Michael Conway).
Hold a site visit and continue the 322 Townsend Harbor Road hearing (Request for Determination of Applicability filed by Larry H. King) to October 1 at 7:15 PM.
votes.quote: a motion was made to do a site visit and continue

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for removal of 4 large oak trees at 116 Island Road (Request for Determination of Applicability filed by John/Cathy Beale).
votes.quote: will trim 1 tree with written permission of the hhla. negative 3 unanimous

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for a new septic system leach field at 71 Brookview Terrace (Request for Determination of Applicability filed by Matthew Peaslee).
votes.quote: all work within the 100' buffer zone. negative 3 unanimous
